description:
Cool things to learn, honestly explained.

Brain Cubed takes something worth knowing and makes it click: how it works, why it happens, and where
it came from. It leans toward science and the way things work, but anything fascinating is fair game.

Every video is researched and fact-checked against primary sources. When a topic is contested, you get
each side's strongest case, the evidence behind it, and what's still uncertain, so you can make up your
own mind. No hype and no filler.

Curious about something? Ask in the comments. It might be the next video.

Animations are original illustrations made for this channel, narration is a synthetic voice.

TikTok @realBRAINcubed
Insta @realBRAINcubed
